subject.title: [Feature]: Feishu Group Chat SubAgents for User-Specific Skills and Memory

question: Should Feishu group chats create persistent per-sender agents automatically, or should OpenClaw keep group chats on sender-scoped sessions plus explicit configured agents/subagents?
rationale: The request changes product semantics and security boundaries by letting group members create isolated agents with skills, memory, and hot configuration rather than only routing messages to existing sessions.

options.title: Keep open for design
options.body: Use this issue as the product/security design thread for Feishu group per-user agents before any implementation lane starts.

options.title: Narrow to session isolation
options.body: Reject automatic agent creation and track only sender-scoped Feishu session/memory isolation as the supported core behavior.

options.title: Move to external plugin
options.body: Require this workflow to live in a Feishu/organization plugin unless maintainers identify a missing generic plugin API.

recommendation.title: Keep open for design
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the product/security design thread for Feishu group per-user agents before any implementation lane starts.

likelyOwner.reason: This is Feishu-specific channel behavior, and the Feishu plugin reference names m1heng as the community maintainer for that plugin surface.
